reason: With the experimental FlagExpressionParser off, buildCMDNode skips the reader block at nodes.go:123-146 and runs UnmarshalSQLCommand (nodes.go:159-160). That calls NewSQLCommand, then sql.TablesList (sql_command.go:30), then the new stub RunCommands (parser.go:26, db.go:16-18). The stub fails, so parser.go:28 logs an Error and sql_command.go:32-34 logs a Warn, both with the raw SQL, and the user gets BadRequest 'sql-invalid-sql'. The patch's only FlagSqlExpressions check is in reader.go:129-132, which this path never reaches.
